# Tubelight

Tubelight is a visual explainer for Windows 10 and 11. Select text in a PDF, browser or document and press Alt + E. Tubelight opens beside your work and explains the passage with illustrated slides, narration and captions. You can also type a topic.

- [See how Tubelight works](https://tubelight.net/#how)
- [Watch examples or try a topic](https://tubelight.net/#examples): Watch saved explanations or generate one free web preview per day. Joining the waitlist unlocks the custom preview.
- [Join early access](https://tubelight.net/#join): Invitations go out in batches. Members can earn invite priority by answering optional questions or referring a friend who joins.
- [Product and privacy questions](https://tubelight.net/#faq): Selected text goes to the servers that generate the explanation. Tubelight keeps explanation records and stores saved explanations on the PC.
- [Quick Search AI](https://search.tubelight.net/): A separate Windows app for short, sourced web answers using Tab + Q.
